plan_a_advantages: Includes a tempo run to improve lactate threshold and running speed.
Features a long run to build endurance and trail-specific durability.
Offers a more varied training week, promoting broader development.
plan_b_advantages: Higher total volume of easy running may contribute to aerobic base building.
Simpler structure might be easier to adhere to for some athletes.
reasoning: Plan A is the better choice for an athlete aiming to become a faster trail runner. While both plans incorporate rest days, Plan A includes a tempo run and a long run, which are crucial for developing speed and endurance respectively. Plan B consists almost entirely of easy runs, which, while important for building a base, won't sufficiently challenge the athlete to improve their speed or trail-specific durability. The variety in Plan A, with its focus on different intensities and durations, provides a more well-rounded approach to training.
